why: The FEX project's own ARMv8.0-clean Windows modules (0 LSE/RCPC instructions, and the DEP-disabled mode FEX-2607+ has) replace the older FEX-2605 pair in the community Proton tool, which has no DEP-disabled mode: pre-NX 32-bit programs (RollerCoaster Tycoon Deluxe, Carmageddon 2, Quake III's QVM JIT) die with 'NoExec instruction in entry block'. Stock upstream binaries, not built by us (operator 2026-10-10: no custom FEX builds). Also needs Valve's own wow64.dll (the half that tells FEX the process has DEP disabled), which comes from Valve's Proton app after sign-in (docs/WISPOS-COMPAT-LAYER-SPEC.md, 2a). Measured: Quake III 26.4 fps, Worms regression OK, Carmageddon 2 past NoExec (docs/WISPOS-NOTES.md, STOCK-BINARY RESULT).
